memory_unit: The contest document says GB without specifying byte counts. Local profiles use GiB (1024^3 bytes).

warmup.note: Evaluator standardizes the warmup procedure; duration is not published.

recovery_probe.timing: from Open start through completion of final readback
recovery_probe.thread_count_note: The document does not specify recovery-probe concurrency; local profile uses one thread.

performance.page_cache_policy: Evaluator clears the OS page cache before each performance test and round, then leaves it alone during measurement.

scoring.gate: Correctness and both performance minimums must pass before objective scoring.

correctness.num_keys_policy: Keep public per-scenario defaults; do not replace every correctness case with 200 million keys
correctness.key_value_policy: Keep each public scenario's default sizes, including large-key/value edge cases. Performance dataset uses 16..32 B keys and 256 B values.
correctness.rss_allowance: The public runner allows 8 MiB plus its explicit reference-state storage where applicable, in addition to floor(1.1 * mem_limit_bytes).
correctness.fixed_basic_cases: Public Basic retains its manually constructed binary, empty and long key/value cases

paired_dataset: Use the same key size, seed, generator and 200 million distinct key IDs in both memory tiers
score_policy: Do not calculate an official rank or total score from local benchmark runs.
